summary: TLC The Language Centre is a Ministry of Education licensed school in Hua Hin teaching Thai, English and Chinese, with one-year education visa courses.

facts.label: Licence
facts.value: Licensed by the Ministry of Education
facts.quote: Licensed by the Thailand Ministry of Education, TLC has taught thousands of students

facts.label: ED visa
facts.value: One-year education visa with a one-year course, Thai or English lessons included
facts.quote: With an education visa you get Thai or English lessons included.

facts.label: Course length
facts.value: One year course for the education visa
facts.quote: attend a one year course in a feature of Thai culture, such as Thai Language lessons

facts.label: Languages
facts.quote: qualified Thai, English and Chinese instructors
